children: Stock-specific action remained in focus on Dalal Street on October 26, with investors reacting to brokerage recommendation, corporate developments and quarterly earnings.

Shares of Jyoti Structures advanced 10 percent as company has received Notifications of Award from Power Grid Corporation of India for ±800 kV HVDC Bipole Barmer-II & South Kalamb Transmission Lines for package TL01 & TL02 in Rajasthan worth of Rs 949.35 crore.

SBI Funds Management share price shed nearly 5 percent after reporting a 6 percent year-on-year decline in Q2 consolidated profit to Rs 701.2 crore, despite an 8.9 percent rise in revenue to Rs 1,192.7 crore.

Share price of Bank of India fell 4 percent despite reporting a 25.4 percent year-on-year increase in Q2 standalone profit to Rs 3,202.4 crore and an 18.5 percent rise in net interest income to Rs 7,007.2 crore. However, provisions and contingencies surged 80.7 percent to Rs 797.4 crore.

Torrent Pharmaceuticals share price gained nearly 2 percent after reporting a 9.6 percent year-on-year decline in Q2 consolidated profit to Rs 534 crore, despite a 50.8 percent jump in revenue to Rs 4,979 crore.

Bharat Coking Coal share price gained 5 percent after reporting a Q2 profit of Rs 123.74 crore against a loss of Rs 53 crore a year ago, while revenue grew 39 percent year-on-year to Rs 4,412.6 crore.

IDFC First Bank shares shed 3 percent as Goldman Sachs maintained 'neutral' rating with target price at Rs 85. Goldman Sachs said IDFC First Bank's Q2 PAT stood at Rs 1,050 crore, translating to an annualised return on assets (RoA) of 0.9%, broadly in line with expectations. Core pre-provision operating profit (PPoP) beat estimates by 2%, while core revenue grew 22% year-on-year against 16% cost growth. Loan growth excluding FCNR(B) remained strong at 21%, with management expecting growth above 20% to continue, while deposit growth moderated to 14% as the bank reduced high-cost bulk deposits.
Broader indices were trading lower with Nifty Midcap index down 0.45%, and smallcap index shed 0.8%.
Among sectors, except metal, pharma, private bank, all other indices were trading lower with auto, FMCG, PSU Bank, realty down 0.5-1%.
Market breadth on the BSE remained negative, with 1339 shares advancing, 2137 declining and 170 remaining unchanged.

title: Price Action: IDFC First Bank sheds 3% as Goldman Sachs maintains 'neutral' rating; Jyoti Structures gains 10% on order win
